note: Seven stages to the platinum, in play order. Stage trophy lists are the stage field on each trophy in trophies.json.

stages.goal: Play the story to the end. Every chapter and mission trophy pops on the way; nothing here can be missed.
stages.tip: Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter (15 manual slots + 1 autosave). Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before the chapter ends.
stages.title: Story first

stages.goal: Finish the character quest chains (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) and 8 Strangers & Freaks strands.
stages.tip: Do Yago's Race Against Yago the moment the hourglass icon appears in Chapter 3 — it is the one possibly missable step in the whole list.
stages.title: Strangers & side strands

stages.goal: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges, win the races and drone races, finish the stunt, challenge and focus trophies.
stages.tip: Range time raises Focus, which helps Gunslinger. Race golds and drone time trials also feed the 100% checklist.
stages.title: Activities & skill

stages.goal: Meditate at all 18 spots, finish card sets, WAiNK 100 locations, discover 100 vehicles and explore all of Leonida.
stages.tip: Meditation is the only collectible with a disputed Chapter 1 step — do the balcony early (see the Sources disagree box on Positive Mental Attitude).
stages.title: Collectibles & exploration

stages.goal: Rob the vaults, trucks, shops and gang operations; fence $250,000 of marked bills; buy the garages.
stages.tip: Bring your partner to the vaults — you cannot carry all the money alone. A vault can hold up to $205,000, nearly the whole Dime on the Dollar target.
stages.title: Robberies & money

stages.goal: After the story, the 100% checklist opens in Progress > Stats: 35 lines, 11 with no slack. Clear them for A Long Road.
stages.tip: Eleven lines need everything (story, gang ops 39/39, bank jobs 22/22, vaults 8/8, drone trials 42/42, range golds 42/42). Most other lines need less than the full count.
stages.title: Cleanup: the 100% checklist

stages.goal: Vice Got a Price! unlocks automatically once the other 54 are earned.
stages.tip: Budget around 200 hours for the full run; some guides estimate 250–300 hours. The final heat is the checklist, not the story.
stages.title: Platinum
